## Before review

- [ ] I am authorized to publish these examples and have recorded public-sharing and training choices per example.
- [ ] I sanitized locally before adding files to Git or this PR; no raw exports, screenshots, credentials, or personal histories are included.
- [ ] Names, actual account suffixes, identifiers, references, amounts/dates, and links were replaced without adding category evidence.
- [ ] Evidence quotes occur in the sanitized message; unknowns and private-context cases remain uncertain.
- [ ] Draft/AI-assisted labels are identified; human-reviewed fields list only what was actually checked.
- [ ] Related examples have grouping metadata; I have not assigned test/train membership or treated variants as independent tests.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_contribution_data.py` passes across the contribution directory.
- [ ] I inspected the staged diff. I understand validation cannot certify privacy or label correctness, and merge does not automatically approve training use.
